description: Upload a file into a Files surface (kind='files'). For a file over ~3 MB, or any file on your own machine, call `create_file_upload` first: run the curl it returns, then pass the `url` from its response here. You never need a public host to put your own file into Dock. Small files can instead go inline as base64 in `content_base64` (a bare base64 string or a data: URL), capped ~3 MB, the request-body limit. Provide exactly one of `content_base64` / `url`. The server sniffs the MIME from magic bytes (don't trust the extension), enforces an allowlist, sanitizes SVGs, strips EXIF from images, and counts the bytes against your plan's storage quota. Returns the created file's {id, name, size, mimeType, parentFolderId, createdAt}. `surface_slug` is required (use list_surfaces to find the files surface); `parent_folder_id` defaults to the surface root.

content_base64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded. Accepts a bare base64 string or a "data:<mime>;base64,..." data URL. ~3 MB cap. Provide this OR `url`, not both.

mime.description: Optional MIME hint. The server still sniffs magic bytes; this only helps for extension-less or ambiguous content.

parent_folder_id.description: Optional folder id (from list_files) to place the file in. Defaults to the surface root.

surface_slug.description: The Files surface slug to upload into (required).

url.description: The `url` a `create_file_upload` link returned (large-file path; no request-body limit). Provide this OR `content_base64`, not both.

name: upload_file
